scientific_question: On identical deterministic oracle-success states, does replacing imperfect teacher next-action targets with exact oracle-path actions produce fresh-task closed-loop improvement?
hypothesis: H1.18 was confounded because only 36 of 96 teacher actions matched the deterministic successful path. If action-label fidelity is causal, ORACLE-ACTION should selectively outperform both the matched TEACHER-ACTION control and BASE on fresh tasks.
independent_variable: next-action supervision target only: H1.18 teacher action versus exact metadata.oracle_action

arms.TEACHER-ACTION: existing H1.18 rank-4 SD-LoRA adapter trained on the 96 teacher-action records
arms.ORACLE-ACTION: new rank-4 SD-LoRA adapter trained on the same 96 prompts/states with exact deterministic oracle-action targets

cpu_audit.claim_boundary: The audit establishes a supervision-fidelity confound, not causal transfer or Q3.

training_panel.state_selection: the same first four pre-buy deterministic oracle-success states used by H1.18

evaluation_panel.task_role: fresh held-out evaluation only; no outcome or trace may enter training

primary: scientific-valid qualified-positive rate by arm and task
mean final task_score over scientific-valid attempts

positive_rule: ORACLE-ACTION strictly exceeds both BASE and TEACHER-ACTION on aggregate complete-valid paired score and on at least two task identities for which all four seed trios are valid; then preregister independent new-task/new-seed confirmation before Q3.
negative_rule: If ORACLE-ACTION does not satisfy the positive rule, stop 3B parametric rescue variants and redesign agent/task decomposition; keep Q3, H2, D0, retention, transfer, and SEED locked.
invalid_rule: Exclude invalid attempts from scientific denominators and repair only the runtime/provenance fault without changing tasks, seeds, labels, arms, or protocol.

runtime_contract.python_venv_mount: read-only at the same absolute path
runtime_contract.formal_execution_git_sha: must equal the launch-authorized server clone HEAD and is recorded by every run plus reconciliation

tracking.offline_fallback: only after an exact online initialization/upload failure is captured with error and spool hash

launch_gate: Authorized after model-ID/read-only-cache repair 0cab706 and green CPU CI run 31951298857 at head 762e234 (39 unittest tests); the launcher repeated runtime, CUDA, W&B, resource, cache, dataset, adapter, and exact-revision gates before formal consumption.

completion.decision: Stop 3B parametric rescue variants and redesign agent/task decomposition; Q3, H2, ordinary-LoRA comparison, retention, transfer, and SEED remain locked.

claim_boundary: Matched action-label-fidelity diagnostic only; no Q3, H2, ordinary-LoRA comparison, retention, transfer, SEED, or general OpenEvo efficacy claim without independent confirmation.
